name: Weekly Quality Scorecard
outcome: Give the owner a weekly review of intake completeness, unresolved follow-ups, event coverage, attendance and process reliability.
guardrails: Quality indicators must be defined before reporting.
Do not present synthetic counts as clinic results.
Do not score clinical quality or clinician competence without an approved validated measure.
activation_requirements: Clinic owner approves metric definitions and thresholds.
Source coverage and data quality are documented.
Review cadence and owner for each corrective action are agreed.
